whole-sign-physical-occupation-v1.label: Whole Sign physical occupation
whole-sign-physical-occupation-v1.formula: house = 1 + ((graha Rasi index - Lagna Rasi index + 12) mod 12)
whole-sign-physical-occupation-v1.precedence: Canonical local Drik/Lahiri Lagna overrides sidecar house and Lagna fields; physical occupation does not imply aspect or lordship.
whole-sign-physical-occupation-v1.conflict_resolution: Missing, conflicting or transition-guarded Lagna/Rasi facts return unknown; other house systems are not blended.

phaladeepika-full-graha-drishti-v1.label: Phaladeepika full Graha Drishti
phaladeepika-full-graha-drishti-v1.formula: delta = (target Rasi - source Rasi + 12) mod 12; all seven classical grahas use {6}, Kuja also {3,7}, Guru also {4,8}, and Shani also {2,9}.
phaladeepika-full-graha-drishti-v1.precedence: A directed registered full aspect is evidence; conjunction, self, partial and node aspects do not satisfy this convention.
phaladeepika-full-graha-drishti-v1.conflict_resolution: Partial-aspect traditions and node-aspect traditions remain named alternatives and are not blended into a full-aspect result.

alternatives.reason: The current event rules request full aspects only.
No node-aspect authority or geometry is selected.

same-rasi-distributive-conjunction-v1.label: Same-Rasi distributive Chandra conjunction

thresholds.degree_orb: none; equality of sidereal Rasi only

same-rasi-distributive-conjunction-v1.precedence: Either known equality controls a prohibition; pass requires both inequalities to resolve.
same-rasi-distributive-conjunction-v1.conflict_resolution: This event-bounded mode is not a global conjunction default. Missing/conflicting facts return unknown; angular-orb traditions remain unresolved. The reusable primitive is implemented, while the borrowing event effect remains unwired.

The grammar is represented as a distributive OR.

court-peace-benefic-subject-continuity-v.label: Court peace-pattern subject continuity
court-peace-benefic-subject-continuity-v.formula: exists p: natural_benefic(p) and H(p) in {1,4,7,10}, OR exists distinct p,q: natural_benefic(p) and odd_Rasi(R(p)) and natural_benefic(q) and full_aspect(q,p)

thresholds.male_rasis: Mesha, Mithuna, Simha, Tula, Dhanu, Kumbha
thresholds.aspect_mode: full sign-based classical Graha Drishti only

court-peace-benefic-subject-continuity-v.precedence: Either resolved OR arm passes. Without a pass, a potentially satisfying unresolved nature, Rasi boundary or aspect returns unknown; only a fully resolved miss returns fail. The event effect is inform only.
court-peace-benefic-subject-continuity-v.conflict_resolution: The subject remains benefics in both arms. The odd-Rasi benefic is the aspect receiver and the aspector must be another resolved natural benefic. Partial aspects, node aspects, self-aspect, functional beneficence and adverse legal inference are excluded.

alternatives.reason: It reverses the selected receiver direction of 'occupying the male Rasis have beneficial aspects'.
It drops the grammatical subject continuity from 'benefics'.

phaladeepika-natural-graha-nature-whole-.label: Phaladeepika natural graha nature with Whole Sign association
phaladeepika-natural-graha-nature-whole-.formula: Fixed malefics are Surya, Kuja, Shani, Rahu and Ketu; fixed benefics are Guru and Shukra. Chandra nature follows the selected Paksha convention. Budha is malefic when it shares a Rasi with a resolved natural malefic and benefic otherwise.
phaladeepika-natural-graha-nature-whole-.precedence: A known prohibited malefic controls over another occupant whose nature is unknown; functional lordship is outside this classifier.
phaladeepika-natural-graha-nature-whole-.conflict_resolution: Phase-unknown Chandra can make associated Budha unknown. Aspect, dispositor and degree-orb association are not inferred.

alternatives.reason: Functional nature depends on Lagna and is separate.
Neither cited source supplies a numerical orb.

phaladeepika-kapoor-fixed-elongation-com.label: Kapoor fixed-elongation combustion
inputs: Surya and target graha sidereal longitudes

raman-180-degree-paksha-v1.label: Raman 180-degree Paksha split
raman-180-degree-paksha-v1.formula: E = (longitude(Chandra) - longitude(Surya)) mod 360; waxing for 0.02 < E < 179.98; waning for 180.02 < E < 359.98.
raman-180-degree-paksha-v1.precedence: The phase classification affects only rules that explicitly consume natural Chandra nature or waxing/waning state.

classical-seven-graha-rasi-lordship-v1.label: Classical seven-graha Rasi lordship
inputs: complete canonical nine-graha Rasi position facts
optional target Whole Sign shortest distance
classical-seven-graha-rasi-lordship-v1.formula: Mesha/Vrischika -> Kuja; Vrishabha/Tula -> Shukra; Mithuna/Kanya -> Budha; Karka -> Chandra; Simha -> Surya; Dhanu/Meena -> Guru; Makara/Kumbha -> Shani. For two lord positions, distance = min(abs(R1-R2), 12-abs(R1-R2)).

thresholds.court_maximum: exactly 6 under the separate Court project policy

classical-seven-graha-rasi-lordship-v1.precedence: Classical lord identity and observed Rasi separation are reusable facts; event effects remain outside this primitive. Rahu and Ketu never become sign lords.
classical-seven-graha-rasi-lordship-v1.conflict_resolution: Missing, malformed, duplicate or conflicting canonical position facts return unknown. Co-lordship traditions and node lordship are not blended. A shared owner has distance zero.

alternatives.reason: Version 1 uses only the seven classical grahas attested by the selected source table.
The Court source supplies no degree orb, angular threshold or precision rule.
A query-relative maximum would make the same chart change status when unrelated candidates are added.
